spec_match.rationale: Four detectors each probe the exact surface (dictionary member read during conversion, CanvasToneMappingMode enum validation, default reflection, extended reflection); recommends branching on extended reflection, which is what the WPT pins.

interactive.rationale: Run-detectors button fills a results table; a second button lets the app pick its rendering path and actually creates the chosen context, showing the reported attributes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index blurb for this concept describes exactly the controls and readouts delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Documents the measured false-positive (Chrome 153 reflects a constant "standard" with the feature off) and the partial state (parsed but not reflected) — both observed live.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5077164932333568 plus the spec PR / explainer / WPT relevant to the angle.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level conformance.json (9 assertions) pins member read, default/{}/extended reflection on both hosts, enum TypeError, unaltered pixels and the WPT PNG encode expectations; on Chrome 153 + flag it scores 6 pass / 3 fail, so the probes can return false.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), flag off and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: flag off → memberRead=false, enumValidated=false, reflectsStandard=true, reflectsExtended=false; flag on → true/true/true/false. App chose the SDR fallback path both times. Console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the detector results and labels the chosen HDR vs SDR-fallback path.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for text and backgrounds; pressed buttons invert to text-black/bg-ivory with accent-blue outline; status colours accent-emerald-dark/accent-rose on light surfaces. Canvas pixel colours are drawn data, not UI text.

accessibility.rationale: Keyboard-operable native controls with accessible names (fieldset/legend, role=group labels, label for=), visible focus rings, results in a single polite live region, tables with captions and scope=col headers. Accessibility tree not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 with every control driven; tables fit or scroll inside a labelled focusable region; tap targets >= 44px measured.

openQuestions.title: Capture the full-support branch on Chrome 160 / Canary
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153 (the only build here) parses and validates toneMapping behind the flag but still reflects "standard" for "extended". Re-run on a Chrome 160 or current Canary build with --enable-blink-features=CanvasToneMapping and confirm the MATCH / PASS branches and the native-success telemetry asserts.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Names, roles and live regions were set per guidance and checked in the DOM, but chrome-devtools-mcp was not available to inspect the accessibility tree (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Size touch targets to at least 44x44 on touch screens and let components adapt to the available width.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons/selects/ranges are min 44px; control groups use auto-fit minmax(min(100%,15rem),1fr) grids with flex-wrap; result tables sit in a focusable scroll region and break long API names.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0 and every .table-wrap scrollWidth - clientWidth = 0 at 360x740.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons with state exposed, labelled groups, and visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native <button aria-pressed> inside fieldset/legend + role=group aria-label; :focus-visible 3px accent-blue outline; results announced through one role=status aria-live=polite readout.

guidanceConsulted.query: HDR canvas float16 extended dynamic range
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: No guide covers HDR canvas tone mapping; the search returned only general canvas/HTML guides.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception recorded: the demo follows the WHATWG PR #11734, the ColorWeb-CG explainer and the WPT tests directly, with capability detection and honest SDR fallbacks.

summary: Inspection/tooling angle: shows why a naive key check is a false positive and which probe to branch on, with measured evidence from two flag states.
